description: This Java source file defines a test helper class CreateCoreUuids within the org.openmrs.test package. The class extends BaseContextSensitiveTest and contains a method getUUIDs() that generates SQL update statements to assign UUIDs to various core metadata entities in the OpenMRS database. The method interacts with various OpenMRS services to retrieve entities such as form fields, patient attributes, encounter types, concepts, locations, relationship types, roles, and users, printing out corresponding update SQL snippets to standard output. The class is annotated with @Disabled to prevent it from executing as a test, indicating its utility as a script for maintenance or setup purposes.

classes.name: CreateCoreUuids
classes.description: A helper class for generating SQL update statements to assign UUIDs to core metadata entities for the OpenMRS platform, used primarily during database setup or maintenance.

methods.name: getUUIDs
methods.description: Generates and prints SQL update statements for setting UUIDs of various core entities such as form fields, person attributes, encounter types, concepts, patient identifiers, locations, relationship types, roles, and users by fetching data from OpenMRS services and formatting the output.

methods.name: useInMemoryDatabase
methods.description: Overrides the base method to specify not to use an in-memory database, ensuring the test runs against a real database defined by the runtime environment.
